Class Constraints

java.lang.Object
iu.validation.Constraints
final class Constraints extends Object
The rule for each built-in Jakarta Validation constraint annotation.

Every rule but NotNull, NotEmpty, NotBlank, and Null treats a null value as valid, per the specification: absence is NotNull's concern alone, so a property can be optional and still be constrained when present.

    • isUnsupportedConstraint

      static boolean isUnsupportedConstraint(Class<? extends Annotation> annotationType)
      Determines whether an annotation type declares itself a constraint that this class has no rule for.

      A custom constraint is meta-annotated Constraint. Detecting these rather than ignoring them is deliberate: a constraint that silently does nothing is worse than one that refuses to run.

      Parameters:
      annotationType - annotation type
      Returns:
      true if annotationType is meta-annotated Constraint but is not registered; else false

    • appliesToDefaultGroup

      static boolean appliesToDefaultGroup(Annotation constraint)
      Determines whether a constraint declaration applies to the default validation group.

      An empty groups() means Default, so an unqualified constraint applies. A declaration that names only other groups does not.

      Parameters:
      constraint - constraint annotation
      Returns:
      true if the declaration applies to Default; else false

    • unwrapRepeatable

      static Annotation[] unwrapRepeatable(Annotation annotation)
      Unwraps a repeatable constraint container, such as @Pattern.List.

      Detected structurally rather than by name: a container declares value() returning an array of an annotation type that is Repeatable by the container. This covers every built-in List container and any custom repeatable constraint, and returns every element rather than only the first.

      Parameters:
      annotation - annotation that may be a repeatable container
      Returns:
      contained annotations, in declaration order; null if annotation is not a repeatable container
